outcomes.name: The change network has been refined based on pilot learnings
The change network is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Strategic Direction & Leadership to identify what needs to change in the change network before scaling.
Refine the change network to Strategic Direction & Leadership based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined change network covering Strategic Direction & Leadership ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined change network for Strategic Direction & Leadership is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the change network for Strategic Direction & Leadership remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the change network affected People Experience & Culture.
Adapt the change network relating to People Experience & Culture for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the change network covering People Experience & Culture to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor People Experience & Culture among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the change network for People Experience & Culture.
